title: Cycle-cut signed arc covariance
statement: After revealing a directed cycle but hiding its cut, control the adapted signed off-diagonal arc covariance together with the baseline and exact Pythagorean gains by a dimension-free constant.

signature.representation: Uniform directed cycle plus hidden cut, with frozen residual rows and random cyclic-arc masks
signature.state_or_invariant: Arc-incidence Gram covariance, baseline frame energy, and conditional-regression Pythagorean increments
signature.core_candidate_lemma: The full cycle average pays for the signed off-diagonal nested arc covariance without the O(n) loss of scalar Hardy summation.
information_discarded: a pathwise bound for each cut
signature.target_implication: A dimension-free tail-to-baseline comparison plus a local frame floor gives C_G>=c mu A^-1 and hence C051.
signature.known_failure_mode: Equal arbitrary arc coefficients have a normalized Hardy loss of order n, and signed adaptation can defeat a diagonal-only estimate.
signature.verifier_class: exact cycle enumeration, Fourier or incidence-Gram identities, and structured hostile families
